-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [PagoFacturacion] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_PagoDocumento_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Documento_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Usuario_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @PagoDocumentoFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		PagoDocumento_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @PagoDocumentoFilter (PagoDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[PagoDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[PagoDocumento]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[PagoDocumento].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @PagoDocumentoFilter (PagoDocumento_Id)
		SELECT 
			[PagoDocumento].Id
		FROM [dbo].[PagoDocumento]
		WHERE
			 (([PagoDocumento].[Documento_Id] = @Documento_Id) OR (@Documento_Id = 0)) AND
         (([PagoDocumento].[Usuario_Id] = @Usuario_Id) OR (@Usuario_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[PagoDocumento].[Id],
		[PagoDocumento].[Documento_Id],
		[PagoDocumento].[Monto],
		[PagoDocumento].[FechaDePago],
		[PagoDocumento].[FechaRegistro] as FechaRegistro_UTCT,
		[PagoDocumento].[Usuario_Id],
		[PagoDocumento].[MetodoPago_Id],
		[PagoDocumento].[Referencia],
		[Documento].[Folio] AS [FacturacionFolio],
		[Usuario].[CorreoElectronico] AS [UsuarioCorreoElectronico],
		[Usuario].[Nombre] AS [UsuarioNombre]
	FROM @PagoDocumentoFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[PagoDocumento] 
			ON [PagoDocumento].[Id] = filter.[PagoDocumento_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Documento]
		ON [dbo].[PagoDocumento].[Documento_Id] = [dbo].[Documento].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Usuario]
		ON [dbo].[PagoDocumento].[Usuario_Id] = [dbo].[Usuario].[Id] 

 
END
-- END OF [dbo].[cgp_PagoDocumento_Index]
Name: rpt_PagoDocumento_Index
